chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Mālik ibn ʿAṭiyyah, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
Regarding a woman who falsely accuses a man, he عليه السلام said: “She is to be flogged with eighty lashes.”

key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ: a woman, the female subject of the ruling
key_terms.تُجْلَدُ: she is to be flogged as a prescribed punishment
key_terms.جَلْدَةً: a lash or stroke of flogging
key_terms.رَجُلًا: a man, the one against whom the accusation was made
key_terms.قَذَفَتْ: falsely accused or slandered with a charge affecting honor

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman falsely accuses a man in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for false accusation, stating that a woman who slanders a man is punished with eighty lashes. It reflects the judicial seriousness of qadhf and the protection of personal honor in Islamic law.
